body.text: Total stablecoin market cap sits at $286.9B (Aug 2), down from March's record $320B, even as Circle's Q2 revenue beat expectations.
US regulators miss GENIUS Act's one-year rulemaking deadline
The Fed, OCC, FDIC, NCUA and Treasury all failed to finalize stablecoin rules by the July 18 statutory deadline, leaving issuers without a clear compliance framework into at least H2 2026.
Circle beats on USDC growth despite Q2 revenue miss
Circle posted $701M in Q2 revenue (vs. $713M est.) but shares jumped 7.4% as USDC supply grew 19% to roughly $72B; its Arc blockchain is set for public launch September 16.
Standard Chartered-backed HKDAP stablecoin eyes August launch
Anchorpoint plans to roll out its Hong Kong dollar stablecoin this month for cross-border payments and tokenized assets, distributed B2B2C through approved partners.
Coldcard hardware wallet exploit tops $116M and climbing
A 5-year-old firmware flaw in Coinkite's Coldcard weakened key randomness, letting attackers drain over 5,200 Bitcoin addresses since July 30 in four waves — the third-largest hack of 2026.
Three DeFi bridges drained for $35.6M in a single day

AFX's Arbitrum bridge lost $24.2M in USDC to a validator-signature compromise, while BSquared ($3.9M) and VerusCoin ($7.5M, via a reused bug) were hit the same day; VerusCoin funds moved to Tornado Cash.
Weak-RNG bug in CryptoJS drains $5.7M across five wallet apps

A flawed random-number implementation in the widely used CryptoJS library exposed private keys in multiple wallet apps, adding to a first-half 2026 total of $1.1B lost to phishing and wallet-drain attacks.
